user.title: SecuraCV Setup
user.description: Choose how to connect to your SecuraCV devices.

data_description.setup_mode: Most users should choose 'Canary devices via MQTT' — devices auto-discover via MQTT Discovery.

mqtt_config.title: MQTT Configuration
mqtt_config.description:
Configure MQTT for Canary device auto-discovery.

Canary devices publish to topics under this prefix. Devices will appear automatically in Home Assistant.

data_description.mqtt_prefix: MQTT topic prefix for Canary devices (default: securacv)

kernel.title: Witness Kernel Connection
kernel.description:
Enter the connection details for your SecuraCV Privacy Witness Kernel.

The kernel runs as a Home Assistant add-on, Docker container, or standalone service.

data_description.url: URL of the Privacy Witness Kernel Event API (e.g., http://privacy_witness_kernel:8799)
data_description.token: Bearer token from the kernel's api_token file

both.title: MQTT + Kernel Connection
both.description: Configure both MQTT for Canary devices and HTTP for the Witness Kernel.

data_description.url: URL of the Privacy Witness Kernel Event API
data_description.token: Bearer token from the kernel's api_token file
data_description.mqtt_prefix: MQTT topic prefix for Canary devices (default: securacv)

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the Privacy Witness Kernel. Check the URL and ensure the kernel is running.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid API token. Read the token from the kernel's api_token file.

init.title: Device key management
init.description: Pin, rotate, or unpin a Canary device's Ed25519 public key. Read fingerprints from each device's /enroll page (e.g. http://canary-XXXX.local/enroll).

pin.title: Pin device pubkey
pin.description: Paste the device_id and full 64-character Ed25519 pubkey hex shown on the device's /enroll page.

rotate.title: Rotate pinned key
rotate.description: Replace the existing pin with a new pubkey. The previous key is retained in the audit trail. The mismatch notification for this device (if any) is cleared.

unpin.title: Unpin device
unpin.description: Drop the device's pin. The next publish will TOFU-pin to whatever pubkey arrives.

error.invalid_pubkey_hex: Public key must be exactly 64 lowercase hex characters.
error.device_not_pinned: No pin exists for this device_id.
error.trust_store_unavailable: The trust store isn't loaded for this entry — try reloading the integration.

export_chain.name: Export Witness Chain
export_chain.description: Export the tamper-evident witness chain from a SecuraCV Canary device. The chain contains Ed25519-signed, hash-linked witness records that form a cryptographic proof of all observed events.

format.name: Export Format
format.description: The format to export the chain in

verify_chain.name: Verify Chain Integrity
verify_chain.description: Verify Ed25519 signatures and hash chain integrity for a SecuraCV Canary device. Returns whether the entire witness chain is intact and untampered.
